title: Midday ops bullets — runtime/infra/console weekly prep (scratch)
body:
Quick intro (for myself)
- 30m weekly sync, keep it tight. Goal: unblock rollouts, confirm SLOs, capture actions.
- Tone: operational, concrete actions, avoid long debate in the meeting — move to follow-ups.

Agenda (timeboxed)
1) 00:00–05:00: Quick health pulse (Maya)
   - top 3 telemetry spikes this week (errors, 99p latency, autoscale misses)
   - call out: KV cache evictions on PROD cluster-7 (seen Tue 03/03)
2) 05:00–12:00: Rolling canary status & rollout plan (Diego)
   - canary success rate 98.2% vs 99.5% baseline (investigate reruns)
   - decide: continue canary to 50% or pause for fix? (favored: continue with throttled traffic)
3) 12:00–18:00: Console/Tracing changes (Ashwin)
   - propose reducing trace-sample-rate to 0.5% for text-gen endpoints to cut ingestion costs
   - need quick estimate from Observability team on cost delta before applying
4) 18:00–24:00: Autoscaler/Capacity knobs (SRE lead)
   - autoscaler misfires at short bursts; propose min-pods bump + burst buffer config
   - action: run stress test with 90th percentile seq lengths, measure scale-up time
5) 24:00–28:00: Open blockers / parking lot (all)
   - KV cache eviction root cause hypothesis: suboptimal TTL + hot-key churn
   - backlog items prioritized for next sprint
6) 28:00–30:00: Action-item readout + owners (Ashwin)

Notes to self (pre-meeting)
- Bring numbers, not feelings: 99p numbers, error-class counts, example request ids
- Have rollback playbook link ready (CONFLUENCE:runtime-rollback)
- If canary decision splits team, call follow-up deep dive next day with logs attached

Questions I want answered in the sync
- What's the delta in 99p for long-seq (>4096) after last kernel change? (Riley/SRE)
- Are we seeing correlating OOMs during peak window or just KV thrash?
- Cost impact estimate for lowering trace-sample-rate vs losing debugability

Proposed action items (tentative)
- AI-01: Diego to run a targeted canary with throttled traffic to 50% for 24h and post results (owner: Diego, due: 2026-03-13)
body_cont:
- AI-02: Maya to create a short postmortem stub for KV evictions with timeline + sample request ids (owner: Maya, due: 2026-03-12)
- AI-03: Ashwin to ping Observability for cost estimate on trace sampling and add note to rollout ticket (owner: Ashwin, due: 2026-03-12)
- AI-04: SRE to schedule a 60m stress test validating autoscaler behavior with long sequences (owner: SRE lead - Diego to coordinate, due: 2026-03-18)
- AI-05: Engineering docs: add explicit KV TTL guidance to runtime on-call runbook (owner: Ashwin, due: 2026-03-20)

Parking lot / follow-ups (not for this sync)
- Explore LRU vs time-based TTL hybrid for KV cache (research task)
- Revisit model-variant fallback policies for region outages
- Performance: look into prefetch/warmup heuristic experiments (small spike tests)

Meeting logistics
- Location: Zoom link (default team room) — I will paste before start
- Pre-reads: canary metrics dashboard link + last 7d trace sampling report (attach to calendar)
- Remind SRE to forward any runbook edits into Confluence under 'runtime-ops'

Random scratch lines (delete before final)
- If meeting runs long: cut open blockers and spin-off
- Keep 'who will speak' inline next to agenda items

Post-meeting follow-up template (quick)
- 1-line summary (decision + why)
- Action items (owner, due date)
- Links: dashboards, logs, PRs
- Next sync agenda items (carryover)

Personal check: am I prepared?
- Numbers pulled: yes (dashboard snapshot saved)
- Playbook link: yes
- Observability ping queued: yes
